sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: Communicating intentions and adjusting speed
Every knowledge statement for Communicating intentions and adjusting speed is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
Signal time guidance does not replace the continuous legal distance. The advice about intervening entrances is recorded as a misleading-signal risk, not a permission to shorten the required signal.
Surface-speed examples remain handbook guidance rather than guaranteed safe speeds. All traffic-flow and merge guidance remains subject to lawful limits and safe conditions; no same-speed collision impossibility is asserted.
Open source limitation (verify DE-COMMUNICATION-SIGNAL): The continuous legal signal distance and the advice to wait past intervening entrances can conflict in a short block. Do not invent an exception to the legal distance; issuer clarification is needed for a unified example.
Open source limitation (verify DE-COMMUNICATION-HORN): The generic light-tap advice includes cyclists without repeating the earlier narrow imminent-collision horn exception. Do not teach this as broader permission to sound a horn at cyclists or blind pedestrians.
Open source limitation (verify DE-COMMUNICATION-HYDROPLANING): The wet-traction passage gives approximate speed examples without specifying water depth, tires or other conditions. Do not turn those examples into a guaranteed safe-speed cutoff or a minimum hydroplaning speed.
Open source limitation (verify DE-COMMUNICATION-PHYSICS): The same-direction/same-speed collision-impossibility statement and fixed stopping-distance multiplier omit important conditions. These blanket physical claims are withheld rather than used as universal facts.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.

corpus_stability.reason: Working assessment from a single dated official handbook snapshot; actual revision frequency remains unverified debt in part A.

The generic light-tap advice includes cyclists without repeating the earlier narrow imminent-collision horn exception. Do not teach this as broader permission to sound a horn at cyclists or blind pedestrians.

The same-direction/same-speed collision-impossibility statement and fixed stopping-distance multiplier omit important conditions. These blanket physical claims are withheld rather than used as universal facts.
